title: Yoshua Bengio and Yann LeCun, in their own words
source: Exact words, each linked to where it was said and checked against it.

bengio.quote: I’m deeply concerned by the behaviors that unrestrained agentic AI systems are already beginning to exhibit—especially tendencies toward self-preservation and deception.

lecun.quote: The desire to dominate is not correlated with intelligence at all.

bengio.quote: I am confident we can create AI that demonstrably remains under our control and supports human joy and endeavour.

lecun.quote: The nice thing about an AI system is that you can design it in such a way that it cannot escape its guardrails.

rows.label: On putting a number on it

bengio.quote: I’d rather stay out of the p(doom) game.

lecun.quote: It makes little sense to attribute a probability to an event on which we have agency.
